title: Well Fall
summary: POV down a real well, instrumental heavy metal, no vocal. Lip is locked. Click a sight into open slots B–G, or an ending into H — previews fill [SIGHT] in the prompts.
visualArc: Stone well mouth → drop (riff in) → open sight B → open sight C → open sight D → open sight E → open sight F → open sight G → bottom or none.

sightBank.title: Ring of fire
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: a ring of fire around the full circumference — no source, no heat haze on the brick, we pass through the middle of it and come out the other side unlit
sightBank.description: A hoop of flame with no source. We go through the middle and come out unlit.

sightBank.title: Mine timber
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: the brick giving way to raw mine timber and rail, an abandoned drift shaft, an ore cart tipped on its side halfway up a wall that is now a ceiling
sightBank.description: Brick becomes a drift. The cart is on what used to be a wall.

sightBank.title: Rock, concrete, tile, brick
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: cut rock becoming poured concrete becoming hospital tile becoming brick again
sightBank.description: The lining changes under us and forgets to pick one material.

sightBank.title: Doorknob in clay
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: a seam of wet clay with a doorknob in it, at the height a door would be
sightBank.description: A door that was never framed. The knob is at the right height anyway.

sightBank.title: Someone's shower
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: one course of brick that is bathroom tile, grouted, clean, someone's shower
sightBank.description: One ring of clean grout in the wet shaft, then brick again.

sightBank.title: Feet, fathoms, years
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: brick courses numbered like a measuring tape, feet then fathoms then years
sightBank.description: The well starts counting depth in the wrong units.

sightBank.title: Honeycomb mortar
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: mortar turning to beeswax comb, live bees going up past us through the cells
sightBank.description: The joints become comb. The bees commute the other way.

sightBank.title: Moon in the brick
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: a full moon set into the brick like a window, cratered, close enough to touch, then gone
sightBank.description: A cratered disk in the masonry. We pass it like a porthole.

sightBank.title: Faces in the mortar
sightBank.category: The well forgets what it is
sightBank.prompt: faces in the mortar that look past us, never at us
sightBank.description: Relief faces in the joints. None of them track the fall.

sightBank.title: Pipe dripping up
sightBank.prompt: a leaking cast-iron pipe crossing the shaft, dripping up past us because we are faster than the water
sightBank.description: The leak is slower than the fall, so the drips go the wrong way.

sightBank.title: Pipe chandelier
sightBank.prompt: a junction of six pipes, all leaking, a chandelier of small falling streams we fall through, each one a different color
sightBank.description: Six leaks, six colors. We drop through the chandelier.

sightBank.title: Breaker panel
sightBank.prompt: conduit, then a breaker panel bolted to the curve, its door swinging open
sightBank.description: Someone wired the shaft. The door is still moving.

sightBank.title: Water meter reverse
sightBank.prompt: a water meter still counting, numbers rolling the wrong direction
sightBank.description: The meter is working. It is counting us out.

sightBank.title: Horizontal telephone pole
sightBank.prompt: a telephone pole, horizontal, cleats and all, crossbar strung with dead line
sightBank.description: A pole that thinks the shaft is a street.

sightBank.title: ORANGE TELECOM
sightBank.prompt: utility flags and spray paint on the stone: ORANGE TELECOM, marking nothing
sightBank.description: Locate paint on a well. It marks nothing we can use.

sightBank.title: Elevator that never opens
sightBank.prompt: a closed elevator door in the brick, floor indicator counting down with us, never opening
sightBank.description: The car is keeping pace. The doors stay shut.

sightBank.title: Fiber-optic coil
sightBank.prompt: a glowing fiber-optic cable, one unspooling coil we pass through
sightBank.description: Live glass in the dark. We fall through the loop.

sightBank.title: CITY manhole
sightBank.prompt: a manhole cover set into the wall, labeled CITY, daylight leaking around the rim
sightBank.description: Street iron on the curve. Daylight at the gasket.

sightBank.title: Bats at poker
sightBank.prompt: bats playing poker on a ledge — full table, chips, a hanging bulb, none of them look up as we pass
sightBank.description: A complete game. We are not in it.

sightBank.title: The deal waits
sightBank.prompt: one bat, mid-deal, holding the deal until we are gone
sightBank.description: Courtesy. Then the game continues.

sightBank.title: Painter on a ladder
sightBank.prompt: a ladder with a man on it, painting the shaft, six feet of fresh white above him and nothing below
sightBank.description: He has a job. The job has no bottom.

sightBank.title: Cat, no stairs
sightBank.prompt: a cat on a landing that has no stairs
sightBank.description: The landing is enough. The cat does not care about us.

sightBank.title: Brass diver
sightBank.prompt: a diver in a full brass helmet standing on the wall as if it were the floor
sightBank.description: His down is our sideways. He does not correct it.

sightBank.title: Pigeons turning
sightBank.prompt: a line of pigeons on a pipe, facing in, all turning their heads as we drop
sightBank.description: They track us. They do not leave the pipe.

sightBank.title: Silent choir
sightBank.prompt: a choir in the round, facing inward, mouths open, no sound we can hear
sightBank.description: The well stays quiet. Their mouths are already open.

sightBank.title: Dinner on the brick
sightBank.prompt: two people having dinner on a tiny balcony bolted to the brick, not looking down
sightBank.description: A table for two on the curve. They do not look down.

sightBank.title: Swing on a pipe
sightBank.prompt: a child sitting on a swing hung from a pipe, swinging in a circle around the shaft, we fall through the arc
sightBank.description: The arc is a circle. We are in the way of it once.

sightBank.title: Table for one
sightBank.prompt: a dining table set for one, falling slower than we are — we pass it
sightBank.description: Place setting in free fall. We overtake it.

sightBank.title: Open freezer
sightBank.prompt: a chest freezer, open, still lit, ice fog trailing straight up out of it
sightBank.description: The fog goes up because we are going down faster.

sightBank.title: Level window
sightBank.prompt: a window — framed, curtained, lit from inside — set into the brick, the room behind it level
sightBank.description: A real room, level, behind glass in a vertical shaft.

sightBank.title: Helix stair, empty
sightBank.prompt: a staircase going down the wall in a helix, no one on it
sightBank.description: A way down that we are not using.

sightBank.title: Clock in the masonry
sightBank.prompt: a grandfather clock face in the masonry, hands spinning down
sightBank.description: The hands agree with the fall. The face is brick.

sightBank.title: Bundled mail
sightBank.prompt: someone's mail, still bundled, rubber-banded, passing us
sightBank.description: Addressed. Still wrapped. Going our way, slower.

sightBank.title: Bathtub still full
sightBank.prompt: a bathtub on its side, still full, water not spilling, hanging in the air we pass
sightBank.description: The water stays in. Gravity is busy with us.

sightBank.title: Fridge of this well
sightBank.prompt: a refrigerator door, magnet photos of this well from above
sightBank.description: Family snapshots of the mouth we just left.

sightBank.title: Clothesline across
sightBank.prompt: laundry on a line strung across the diameter, we tear through a sheet
sightBank.description: A diameter of wet cotton. We are the tear.

sightBank.title: Keys, chair, piano
sightBank.prompt: keys, then a folding chair, then a piano, each falling slower than we are
sightBank.description: Household objects in order of size. We pass all three.

sightBank.title: Rain slower than us
sightBank.prompt: rain falling inside the shaft, and it is falling slower than we are
sightBank.description: Interior weather. We outrun the drops.

sightBank.title: Fog, then dry
sightBank.prompt: a layer of fog we punch through and come out the bottom of, dry
sightBank.description: A ceiling of mist. Dry brick underneath it.

sightBank.title: Fish in air
sightBank.prompt: fish, just fish, swimming in air, in a school, in the shaft, going up
sightBank.description: A school commuting the other direction. No water required.

sightBank.title: Frost line
sightBank.prompt: a frost line — one horizontal band where everything is white, then gone
sightBank.description: One cold ring. Then the shaft is wet brick again.

sightBank.title: Sideways thunderstorm
sightBank.prompt: a thunderstorm happening sideways in a gap in the wall
sightBank.description: Lightning in a niche. The rain is horizontal.

sightBank.title: One layer of hail
sightBank.prompt: one layer of hail, then dry brick again
sightBank.description: Ice for a few feet. Nothing above or below it.

sightBank.title: Rainbow as a ring
sightBank.prompt: a rainbow that is a full circle because we are inside it
sightBank.description: The shaft is the missing ground. The bow closes.

sightBank.title: Still water, still falling
sightBank.prompt: the shaft filling with still water while we keep falling through it, breathing
sightBank.description: We are underwater and still falling and still breathing.

sightBank.title: Cathedral, then narrow
sightBank.prompt: the shaft widening into a cathedral of wet brick, then narrowing back before we can read the far wall
sightBank.description: Too much room, then none. We never get a wide shot.

sightBank.title: Second well mouth
sightBank.prompt: a second well mouth opening in the wall — daylight the wrong hour
sightBank.description: Another sky in the brick. The hour does not match ours.

sightBank.title: Outside, then back in
sightBank.prompt: we fall past the outside of a well, seen from a dry hillside, and re-enter
sightBank.description: A cut that is not a cut: the shaft shows us its own exterior.

sightBank.title: A throat
sightBank.prompt: the shaft becoming a throat — not a metaphor — then brick again
sightBank.description: Flesh for a moment. Then masonry resumes.

sightBank.title: Coin above, coin below
sightBank.prompt: a bright coin above us, and a bright coin below us, both shrinking
sightBank.description: Two mouths. Both getting smaller. We are between them.

sightBank.title: Cathedral to racks
sightBank.prompt: brick becoming wet cathedral becoming server racks
sightBank.description: Holy brick, then a data center lining the cylinder.

sightBank.title: Reflection falling up
sightBank.prompt: the well's own reflection falling the other way
sightBank.description: A twin fall, opposite heading, same brick.

sightBank.title: Dollhouse rooms
sightBank.prompt: dollhouse rooms stacked in the brick, lamps on, no dolls
sightBank.description: Tiny interiors with the lights left on. Empty.

sightBank.title: The other camera
sightBank.prompt: another falling camera looking at us, same speed
sightBank.description: A second POV. We see its lens. It sees ours.

sightBank.title: One brick is a wall
sightBank.prompt: the bricks enlarging until one brick is a wall, then returning to normal
sightBank.description: Scale forgets, then remembers, without a cut.

sightBank.title: Live from above
sightBank.prompt: a television on a shelf in the brick, playing the well, from above, live
sightBank.description: Our fall, already on TV, shot from the lip.

sightBank.title: Vending machine
sightBank.prompt: a vending machine, humming, fully stocked, one row empty
sightBank.description: It has power. One row is sold out. We do not stop.

sightBank.title: P4, then P9
sightBank.prompt: a parking garage level marker: P4. Then P9. Then P4 again
sightBank.description: The levels are lying, or the shaft is looping.

sightBank.title: Exit into stone
sightBank.prompt: an exit sign, green, arrow pointing sideways into solid stone
sightBank.description: The sign is sincere. The wall is not an exit.

sightBank.title: Rotary that stops
sightBank.prompt: a rotary phone ringing on a hook, and it stops the instant we are past it
sightBank.description: It was ringing for us. Then it was not.

sightBank.title: EyeWash on a radio
sightBank.prompt: a radio still playing EyeWash, getting louder as we drop — diegetic, not the metal
sightBank.description: Station bleed in the shaft. The metal stays non-diegetic.

sightBank.title: Drive-in of the lip
sightBank.prompt: a drive-in screen in the brick showing the lip we just left
sightBank.description: The last frame we stood in, projected on the way down.

sightBank.title: ATM in the brick
sightBank.prompt: an ATM asking for a PIN, its screen lighting the brick
sightBank.description: A prompt we cannot answer at this speed.

sightBank.title: NEXT WELL 2 MIN
sightBank.prompt: subway tiles and a delay board: NEXT WELL 2 MIN
sightBank.description: A platform announcement for a hole.

sightBank.title: Scoreboard clock
sightBank.prompt: a sports scoreboard: HOME 0 AWAY 0, the clock running our fall time
sightBank.description: No score. The clock is honest about the drop.

sightBank.title: Polaroids of later
sightBank.prompt: polaroids of the fall, already developed, pinned in a sequence we have not reached
sightBank.description: The next sights, already photographed, waiting on the wall.

sightBank.title: Punch-clock depths
sightBank.prompt: a punch-clock, cards stamped with depths
sightBank.description: Time cards that clock distance instead of hours.

sightBank.title: Bare bulb on a cord
sightBank.prompt: a single bare bulb on a long cord, we catch up to it, pass it, it recedes above
sightBank.description: We overtake the only light, then leave it.

sightBank.title: The rope ends
sightBank.prompt: a rope that ends — we pass the fray — nothing below it
sightBank.description: Someone climbed until there was no rope. We keep going.

sightBank.title: Paired shoes
sightBank.prompt: shoes, paired, on a ledge, laces tied together
sightBank.description: Left as if the owner stepped out of them and continued.

sightBank.title: Missing-person flyer
sightBank.prompt: a laminated missing-person flyer taped to the brick, face toward the center
sightBank.description: The flyer is looking at the fall path. We pass the face.

sightBank.title: Ice plug
sightBank.prompt: a solid plug of clear lake ice filling the shaft for twenty feet, bubbles frozen in it, we punch through and come out wet brick again
sightBank.description: A cork of ice. We go through the middle. Brick resumes.

sightBank.title: Ice lining
sightBank.prompt: the wet brick sheathed in a skin of ice, thick enough to show our fall as a blur inside it, no frost-line cutoff, just ice then not
sightBank.description: The cylinder is glazed. We are inside the glaze for a moment.

sightBank.title: Piano-key ring
sightBank.prompt: a complete circle of piano keys set into the brick like a course, ivory and ebony, keys depressing one after another as we pass through the ring, no piano body, no player
sightBank.description: A keyboard that thinks the shaft is a wrist. Distinct from the falling piano.

sightBank.title: Loose piano keys
sightBank.prompt: loose piano keys falling slower than we are, ivory and ebony tumbling, we pass a cloud of them
sightBank.description: The instrument is gone. The notes are still falling.

sightBank.title: Cars being born
sightBank.prompt: an auto assembly line wrapped around the inside of the shaft, unfinished car bodies hanging sideways from an overhead conveyor, spot-weld sparks going up past us, robots working the curve as if it were a floor, no logos, no HUD
sightBank.description: The factory thinks the well is a plant. Cars hang. We do not stop.

sightBank.title: One finished sedan
sightBank.prompt: one finished unpainted sedan hanging in the shaft on a single hook, doors shut, waiting for a line that is not here, we fall past the grille
sightBank.description: The line ended. The car stayed.

sightBank.title: Outer space lining
sightBank.prompt: the brick giving way to a lining of real outer space — stars, a little dust, no planet, no ship, no HUD — the shaft is still a shaft, then brick again
sightBank.description: Space is the masonry for a moment. Not Annex. Not a cutaway.

sightBank.title: Vacuum gap
sightBank.prompt: a gap in the brick where there is no air and no dust, only stars through a missing course, we fall through the missing course and the air comes back
sightBank.description: One course is vacuum. The next course is wet brick.

sightBank.title: Cats eating
sightBank.prompt: several cats on staggered ledges eating from bowls and one shared tin, heads down, chewing, none of them look up as we pass
sightBank.description: Dinner is on. We are not dinner. Distinct from the cat with no stairs.

sightBank.title: Stock market pit
sightBank.prompt: a circular trading pit built into the shaft, jackets, paper tickets, ticker tape falling up past us because we are faster, no readable prices, no HUD, no on-screen titles
sightBank.description: The pit is in the round. Paper goes the wrong way. Numbers stay off-screen.

sightBank.title: Cardboard boxes
sightBank.prompt: the shaft packed with sealed cardboard boxes we have to fall through, packing peanuts trailing straight up out of torn flaps, labels facing in, unreadable
sightBank.description: A chute of brown cardboard. We are the tear.

sightBank.title: Empty boxes stacked
sightBank.prompt: empty cardboard boxes stacked as a spiral staircase against the brick, flaps open, nothing in them, we pass the spiral without using it
sightBank.description: A way down made of boxes. We do not take it.

sightBank.title: Snakes on the brick
sightBank.prompt: live snakes on the wet brick, ordinary scales, coiled and traveling the curve, no glow, no laser, no Halloween lawn, they do not strike, we pass
sightBank.description: Real snakes. Not Ep3. Not a light show.

sightBank.title: The bottom is a sky
sightBank.prompt: a sky where the bottom should be
sightBank.description: No water. No brick. Daylight underneath us.

sightBank.title: Lip from below
sightBank.prompt: the lip of the well from below, as if we are about to arrive at the start
sightBank.description: The mouth we left, approaching from the wrong side.

sightBank.title: Water, one inch
sightBank.prompt: the water surface, one inch away, held there
sightBank.description: Impact delayed. The surface does not move.

sightBank.title: Still falling, cut
sightBank.prompt: nothing changing — the brick keeps coming — a still-falling frame
sightBank.description: No bottom event. Cut on a frame that is still dropping.

sightBank.title: Water as a ceiling
sightBank.prompt: water that is a ceiling — we look up from under ice
sightBank.description: We hit a surface and it is over our heads.

sightBank.title: Underside of a floor
sightBank.prompt: the underside of a living-room floor, joists, about to come through the rug
sightBank.description: The well ends in somebody's house, from below.

sightBank.title: A different well, night
sightBank.prompt: we come out the top of a different well, same hills, night now
sightBank.description: Exit is another mouth. The hour has changed.

sightBank.title: Cover, one inch short
sightBank.prompt: the inner face of a well cover, bolts, we stop one inch short
sightBank.description: The lid from underneath. We never quite hit it.

sightBank.title: The fall inverts
sightBank.prompt: the riff inverting and we fall up — the lip from below, approaching
sightBank.description: Cadence misses by reversing. H is the mouth again.
